newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia launches Mexican scientific satellite.
newsitem.headline: Russia launches Mexican scientific satellite.

text.p: Russia successfully launched a small Mexican-built scientific satellite on Thursday, a defence ministry spokesman said.

"An UNAMSat satellite was launched at 4.48 p.m. Moscow time (1248GMT) together with a Russian military Kosmos satellite," the spokesman said. The launch took place at the Plesetsk cosmodrome in northern Russia.
The spokesman said the 17-kg (37 lb) probe would research small meteorites in orbit.
